# Data export formats

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

The v0.9.4 **Export ModDotPlot command** action writes BEDPE for the current viewport
plus a companion CLI config. The internal CSV serializer remains documented for
programmatic compatibility. Coordinates are zero-based, half-open genomic intervals.
Rows with zero or missing identity are omitted. Before publication,
every visible sketch tile is available at the selected detailed-register tier; terminal
k-mer views use exact tiles. A complete cached detailed/exact viewport is reused without
another worker request.

Both files start with two comment lines:

```text
# moddotplot-interactive current-view ... export
# provenance={...}
```

The JSON provenance records software and export time, method, scheduler policy,
comparison parameters, scientific configurations, display mapping (including the
palette, selected color count, direction, and resolved ordered colors), viewport, and
both sequence records.
FASTA descriptions remain in provenance, but table sequence fields contain only the
FASTA identifier.

## Shared values

For core intervals `X` and `Y`, and half-window expansions `X+` and `Y+`:

```text
C_x = containment(X, Y+)
C_y = containment(Y, X+)
C = max(C_x, C_y)
ANI_c = C^(1/k)
```

`ANI_c` is the containment-derived ModDotPlot display transform, not biological ANI.
The stored renderer value is `round(ANI_c * 10000)`; exported decimal `ani_c` is that
stored value divided by 10000 and printed to four decimal places.

Let `F` and `R` be verified matching-k-mer votes with the same and reverse-complement
relative orientations:

```text
direction_support = F + R
direction = (F - R) / (F + R)
```

`direction` therefore ranges from -1 (entirely reverse) to +1 (entirely forward). It is
missing when `direction_support` is zero.

## BEDPE

The first ten fields follow the conventional BEDPE layout. The final three are
moddotplot-interactive extensions.

| Column | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| `chrom1` | X-axis FASTA identifier |
| `start1` | X interval start |
| `end1` | X interval end |
| `chrom2` | Y-axis FASTA identifier |
| `start2` | Y interval start |
| `end2` | Y interval end |
| `name` | Human-readable `ani_c=<value>` label |
| `score` | Stored identity divided by 10 and rounded, nominally `ANI_c * 1000`, in the BED 0–1000 range |
| `strand1` | `+` when direction is informative; otherwise `.` |
| `strand2` | `+` for nonnegative direction, `-` for negative direction, or `.` without support |
| `ani_c` | Containment-derived display score in `[0,1]` |
| `direction` | Signed direction to six decimal places, or `.` without support |
| `direction_support` | `F + R`, the number of informative orientation votes |

BEDPE sequence identifiers replace tabs or line breaks with underscores so a FASTA
identifier cannot corrupt the tabular structure.

## CSV

CSV is a compact scientific table rather than a renderer/tile diagnostic dump.

| Column | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| `x_seq_id` | X-axis FASTA identifier |
| `x_start` | X interval start |
| `x_end` | X interval end |
| `y_seq_id` | Y-axis FASTA identifier |
| `y_start` | Y interval start |
| `y_end` | Y interval end |
| `ani_c` | Containment-derived display score in `[0,1]` |
| `direction` | Signed direction to six decimal places; empty without support |
| `direction_support` | `F + R`, the number of informative orientation votes |

Sequence identifiers containing commas, quotation marks, or line breaks use standard
CSV quotation and doubled-quotation-mark escaping. Tile coordinates, fixed-point
channels, scales, quality labels, and configuration digests are intentionally omitted;
the genomic intervals and decimal scientific values are the useful row data, while
calculation details remain once in the provenance preamble.
